name: implant
description: Give coding agents live access to the VS Code API — Find References, Rename, diagnostics, any extension command — through an MCP tool.

implant.requireConfirmation.description: Show the approval webview before running each script.

implant.timeoutMs.description: Hard execution timeout per script, in milliseconds. 0 disables the timeout — the user cancels long-running scripts through the notification that appears after 10 seconds. Set to a positive number to also enforce an automatic upper bound.

implant.port.description: Port for the local MCP HTTP server. 0 picks an ephemeral port; the actual port and per-session bearer token are written to .vscode/implant/session.yml in every open workspace folder.

chatParticipants.name: implant
chatParticipants.description: Ask in English, get answers or edits by running vscode.* calls in the extension host.
